heading.html: How It Works: What to Expect from Your Combo Massage

children.text: Whether it’s your first time or you’re a returning guest, here’s a quick breakdown of what to expect during your chair and foot massage combo at King Spa:

children.html: • After checking in and changing into your spa uniform, take time to enjoy the amenities. When you're ready, head to the second-floor reservation desk to book your combo massage.

This spa is a fantastic place to relax and unwind. It reminded me of the spa experiences I enjoyed back in Korea! The place is very clean and modern. I love they have heated outdoor pool which is perfect for couple in the winter! Great variety of sauna rooms as well! We will love to be back again!
Bri C

I cannot say enough wonderful things about King Spa in Chantilly, VA! My husband recently purchased day passes for us as a thoughtful way to help me relax and find peace after the recent loss of my grandparents. We spent the entire day there, from 10am to 6pm, and it was truly a transformative experience. When we first arrived, I’ll admit that the nude area was a bit of a surprise. I had never done anything like that before and was initially uncomfortable, but I quickly realized there was nothing to be nervous about. Everyone was so respectful and welcoming, and the environment felt safe and judgment-free....

My favorite place to unwind and for self-care. I've spend my birthdays there in the past. Even though I have been there recently to introduce King Spa to a friemd, I'm heading back for my birthday in a few days. I just LOVE King Spa!!!!!!!!

children.html:
What is the combo massage at King Spa?

Our combo massage includes a 30-minute chair massage followed by a 30-minute foot massage, designed to relax your back, shoulders, and feet in one balanced session. It’s a great way to experience targeted relief without committing to a full-body massage. Learn more about different types of massage and their benefits in this article from Healthline.

How long is the combo massage?
The service is 60 minutes total—30 minutes focused on the back, neck, and shoulders in a massage chair, followed by 30 minutes of focused foot massage.
Do I need to book an appointment in advance?
Appointments are first-come, first-served and must be booked on-site. Simply visit the second-floor reservation desk during your visit.
What should I wear during the massage?
All guests wear the King Spa-provided uniform during their visit. You’ll remain in this uniform throughout the combo massage—it’s designed for comfort and ease during both the chair and foot portions of your treatment.
Can I get just the chair massage or just the foot massage?

This service is offered only as a 60-minute combination. If you’re looking for something different, our front desk team can suggest other massage options or you can explore all our massage treatments.

How much does the combo massage cost?

Pricing may vary and is separate from the daily admission fee. For the most up-to-date rates and service details, please visit our Pricing Page.
